Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body appreciation was measured using the Body Appreciation Scale (Avalos et al. 2005), a 13-item scale that measures related dimensions of positive body image.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measure of body appreciation used in the study: the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (Avalos et al., 2005), rated 1 (Never) to 5 (Always), with overall scores computed as the mean of items. The authors state they omitted non-Western women from the sample and report Cronbach's alphas of .92 for both US and non-US residents. The section does not report sample size, age, BMI, survey method, or correlations with BMI, nor does it label any study as 'Study 1' or indicate multiple studies.
